# comp: asm → C names

Headers in `src/core/comp/`. `*` marks a label another module uses (`retired/asm32/syms.inc`,
`retired/asm32/ui/syms.inc`); the rest are statics of the module. The token cursor (asm `ESI`) is `comp.p`,
the code's next byte (`EDI`) `comp.out`; the readers also take any cursor as `const uint8_t **p`.

Compile errors: `repl_error` (io's `err_raise`), while `comp.busy` (asm `csp != 0`), calls
`comp_fail(code)`, which emits `ERR`, `EOL` and longjmps to `comp_text`, which returns normally.

## Generated by `tools/x86dfa.py` (C mode; `check` covers both)

`src/core/comp/dfa.h` (tables defined under `DFA_DATA`, in lexer.c) and `src/core/io/gen.h`
(gen.inc's `g_msgs`, `g_kwlist`, `g_kwlist1` as `cons_msgs`, `cons_kwlist`, `cons_kwlist1`, defined
under `GEN_DATA`).

## comp/dfa.h

| asm | C |
|---|---|
| `TK_*`, `TK_X`, `TK1_*` | same names, enum |
| `KW_NC`, `KW_START`, `PS_NC`, `PS_ACC/ERR/EOS/TOK`, `ST_LET`, `ST_GOTO` | same names, enum |
| `A_BASE`, `A_*` (comp/comp.inc) | same names, enum, generated from the grammar |
| `g_kw_cls`* | `lexr_kw_class` |
| `g_kw_off`* | `lexr_kw_first` |
| `g_kw_tc`* | `lexr_kw_char` |
| `g_kw_tn`* | `lexr_kw_next` |
| `g_kw_acc`* | `lexr_kw_token` |
| `g_chr_tok`* | `lexr_char_token` |
| `g_ps_cls`* | `lexr_ps_class` |
| `g_ps_def`* | `lexr_ps_default` |
| `g_ps_off`* | `lexr_ps_first` |
| `g_ps_xc`* | `lexr_ps_xclass` |
| `g_ps_xv`* | `lexr_ps_xentry` |
| `g_ps_ent`* | `lexr_ps_entry` |
| `g_ps_ent1`* | `lexr_ps_entry1` |
| `g_ps_cname`* | `lexr_ps_classname` (an array of strings) |

Defined in lexer.c (`DFA_DATA`), declared `extern const` for comp.c. The parser's entries name
`K_*` (vm/exec.h) and `A_*`: an entry is its code | next state << 8.
